wifi.savedHint: Wi-Fi networks this server remembers. It joins them on its own when they're in range.
wifi.noneSaved: No saved Wi-Fi networks yet. Networks you join are saved here.
wifi.enterpriseHint: Enterprise network: sign in with a user name and password or a certificate
wifi.forgetMsg: The server will no longer join this network on its own. To use it again, join it and enter the password.
wifi.forgetMsgActive: The server is connected to this network now and will disconnect from it. If you're reaching this page over that Wi-Fi, you'll lose the connection.
wifi.autoConnectHint: Join this network automatically when it's in range
wifi.priorityHint: When several saved networks are in range, the highest number wins (-999 to 999)
wifi.priorityRange: Priority must be a whole number from -999 to 999.
wifi.notEditable: This network was set up outside NoCapOS, so its sign-in can't be changed here. Forget it and join again instead.
wifi.shareAuth: Enter your account password to show this network's password and QR code.
wifi.shareScan: Scan with a phone's camera to join this network.
wifi.shareNoEnterprise: The standard Wi-Fi QR code has no fields for enterprise (802.1X) sign-in, and the newer enterprise QR format isn't widely supported by phones. Each person signs in with their own account instead.
wifi.keepSaved: Leave empty to keep the saved one
wifi.caNoneWarn: Without a certificate check, a fake access point could collect your password.
wifi.p12Hint: For a PKCS#12 (.p12 / .pfx) bundle, choose it as the client certificate and leave the private key empty.
wifi.certTooBig: That file is too big (64 KB at most).
